faq.question: 1. What is Reiki healing and how does it work?
faq.answer: Reiki healing is a gentle, non-invasive practice that supports relaxation and emotional balance. Through guided techniques, it helps restore harmony to the mind, body, and spirit.

faq.question: 2. How many Reiki sessions are typically needed?
faq.answer: The number of Reiki sessions varies depending on individual needs. Many clients notice benefits after 2–3 sessions, while a longer programme can support deeper emotional and energetic balance.

faq.question: 3. Does Reiki healing really work?
faq.answer: Reiki supports stress reduction, mental clarity, and emotional wellbeing. While results can vary, clients often report improved calm, focus, and overall vitality after sessions.

faq.question: 4. Can Reiki help with anxiety and stress?
faq.answer: Yes, Reiki is widely used to reduce anxiety and stress. By promoting relaxation and emotional balance, it can help clients feel calmer, more resilient, and centred.

faq.question: 5. What should I expect during a Reiki session?
faq.answer: Sessions are calm and personalised. You may feel deep relaxation, warmth, or gentle tingling. Guided meditation, mindafulness, and reflection help integrate the experience for lasting benefits.

faq.question: 6. Is Reiki suitable for everyone?
faq.answer: Reiki is suitable for adults, children, and even pets. It’s gentle, safe, and supportive for anyone seeking relaxation, stress relief, or emotional harmony.

faq.question: 7. How much does Reiki healing cost at Flowergrid?
faq.answer: Prices vary depending on session length and programme choice. Please contact us to discuss options and book a session tailored to your needs. intro_title: Conscious Living Coaching Helps When You Feel Disconnected, Inauthentic, or Ready for Meaningful Change
intro_points: You feel disconnected from your authentic self and true values
Life looks successful on paper but feels empty inside
You are living for others' expectations instead of your own purpose
Major life decisions feel overwhelming without clear direction
You want to align your daily choices with what actually matters to you
intro_summary: Conscious living coaching aligns your life with your values, builds authentic direction, and creates purposeful, fulfilling living.
approach_title: Our Approach to Conscious Living Coaching

approach_cards.title: H3 #1: Values-Centred, Not Symptom-Focused
approach_cards.text: Conscious living coaching at Flowergrid starts with understanding your core values and what authenticity means for you. Rather than fixing problems, we help you build a life aligned with who you actually are and what genuinely matters.

approach_cards.title: H3 #2: Integrated Mind, Body, and Spirit Work
approach_cards.text: We blend values clarification with emotional support, nervous system regulation, and practical grounding. This integration ensures your conscious living choices are embodied and sustainable, not just intellectual or aspirational ideas disconnected from real life.

approach_cards.title: H3 #3: Practical Authenticity, Not Just Reflection
approach_cards.text: Conscious living coaching includes both deep self-discovery and concrete action steps. You gain clarity on your values and leave with a practical roadmap for living more authentically, making decisions consciously, and building sustainable change. Profile of Practitioner

benefits_items.title: H3 #1: Clarity on Core Values
benefits_items.text: Gain deep understanding of what actually matters to you, not what you think should matter. Build clarity that guides every decision and choice with authentic confidence and purpose.

benefits_items.title: H3 #2: Authentic Living and Self-Expression
benefits_items.text: Move from performing for others to showing up as your true self. Experience freedom and relief from living aligned with your values, not external expectations or inherited patterns.

benefits_items.title: H3 #3: Purposeful Direction and Meaning
benefits_items.text: Build a clear sense of purpose and direction rooted in your values. Experience the fulfillment that comes from living consciously, not just successfully, with genuine meaning and passion.

benefits_items.title: H3 #4: Confident Decision-Making
benefits_items.text: Make major life decisions from clarity rather than fear or obligation. Develop a values-based framework that helps you navigate choices with confidence and minimal regret in any situation.

benefits_items.title: H3 #5: Inner Peace and Integration
benefits_items.text: Experience reduced internal conflict and wholeness when your beliefs, choices, and actions align. Feel grounded, present, and at peace knowing your life reflects who you truly are.

faq.question: 1. What is conscious living coaching?
faq.answer: Conscious living coaching helps you clarify your core values, understand your authentic self, and build a life that genuinely reflects what matters to you. It combines self-discovery with practical tools to help you live purposefully, authentically, and aligned with your true beliefs.

faq.question: 2. How is conscious living coaching different from life coaching?
faq.answer: Life coaching often focuses on goals, productivity, and achievement. Conscious living coaching goes deeper, asking what you truly value and whether your current life reflects those values. It is about authentic alignment, not just external success or life hacks.

faq.question: 3. Who benefits from conscious living coaching?
faq.answer: Anyone seeking authenticity, clarity, or meaningful change can benefit. Whether you are navigating a major life transition, feeling empty despite external success, questioning inherited beliefs, or wanting to live more consciously and purposefully, this coaching offers genuine support.

faq.question: 4. What should I expect in a conscious living coaching session?
faq.answer: Sessions begin with exploration and self-discovery work. You will gain clarity on your values, examine where your life aligns or misaligns with those values, and develop practical strategies for living more consciously and authentically in daily life.

faq.question: 5. How long does conscious living coaching take to show results?
faq.answer: Many clients notice shifts in clarity and self-awareness within 2 to 3 sessions. Deeper values alignment and sustainable life changes typically take 6 to 12 weeks of consistent work. Your coach will help you understand realistic timelines based on your specific journey.

faq.question: 6. Can I do conscious living coaching online or does it need to be in person?
faq.answer: Both options are available. Flowergrid offers conscious living coaching online via secure video call and in-person sessions at our Coulsdon centre. Many clients find online sessions equally effective and more convenient for their schedule and lifestyle.

faq.question: 7. How do I book conscious living coaching at Flowergrid?
faq.answer: Booking is simple. Browse our coaches' profiles, select someone whose approach resonates with you, and reach out via their profile form or contact us at sk@flowergrid.co.uk or +44 7432 211096. We will confirm your session and guide you through the process.

intro_summary: What clients say about Aesthetic and Plastic Surgery at Flowergrid

faq.question: 1) What is included in an Aesthetic and Plastic Surgery consultation at Flowergrid?
faq.answer: Your consultation includes a discussion of your goals, a professional assessment, and clear recommendations on suitable options. You will also receive guidance on safety, risks, recovery time, and realistic outcomes.

faq.question: 2) What procedures do you cover under Aesthetic and Plastic Surgery?
faq.answer: We cover facial procedures such as facelift, rhinoplasty and blepharoplasty, breast procedures such as augmentation, lift and reduction, and body contouring such as liposuction and tummy tuck. Non surgical options may also be discussed.

faq.question: 3) How do you ensure natural looking results?
faq.answer: We focus on proportion, harmony, and what will age well over time. The goal is to enhance your features while keeping you looking like yourself, not chasing trends or dramatic change.

faq.question: 4) Can I choose non surgical treatments instead of surgery?
faq.answer: Yes. During your consultation, we can discuss non surgical options such as Botox, fillers, thread lifts, and skin rejuvenation where appropriate. You will be guided towards what is most suitable and realistic.

faq.question: 5) What is recovery like after aesthetic or plastic surgery?
faq.answer: Recovery depends on the procedure. Your surgeon will explain expected downtime, aftercare steps, and follow up. Planning includes recovery timelines so you can prepare properly and feel supported.

faq.question: 6) Do you offer online consultations?
faq.answer: Yes. Online consultations are available for initial discussions and suitability. In person appointments can be arranged on request, depending on your goals and treatment plan.

faq.question: 7) How do I book Aesthetic and Plastic Surgery at Flowergrid?
faq.answer: You can book by emailing sk@flowergrid.co.uk or calling +44 7432 211096. If you are unsure where to start, we can guide you to the right consultation and practitioner.
